title: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
original_title: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
summary: After publishing a support article in early September outlining usage limits for some Apple Intelligence features, the company has updated Logic Pro with an option to "Buy More Usage" for a one-time…
title_zh: 苹果推出 50 美元 Intelligence 用量包
lead_zh: 在九月初公布部分 Apple Intelligence 功能的用量限制后，苹果已在 Logic Pro 中加入一次性购买更多用量的选项，报道称 50 美元的用量包可扩展部分 AI 功能的使用。
